text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, E, and C after gains felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should assess each decision on its merits.","A loss feels painful, but holding a stock just to avoid realizing a loss can keep me from making a sound decision.","Prices move randomly, so recent changes and my trading record do not reliably predict what comes next; I should avoid reacting to short-term swings."]}
